Olivia T.: Quick sync: QA flagged a handful of small UX + a11y issues in the playground run rows. Dropping the main items here so design/dev can iterate quickly. :clipboard:

Ben K.: thanks — what's top priority?

Olivia T.: 1) Action ambiguity: left-side icon behaves two ways (replay vs details). Users click it expecting the player and get the details sometimes. Suggest two explicit icons: ▶️ Play replay and ▾ Toggle details with aria-labels 'Play replay for run X' and 'Toggle details for run X'.

Renee M.: agree. Implementation detail: keep icons visually similar but update aria-labels to avoid layout shift. Also ensure the toggle is a real <button> with aria-expanded.

Ben K.: tiny snippet I can drop in:
```html
<button class="replay-btn" aria-label="Play replay for invocation #f12">▶️</button>
<button class="details-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Toggle details for invocation #f12">▾</button>
```
Toggle aria-expanded to true when open. Respect prefers-reduced-motion on animations.

Olivia T.: 2) Humanize the summary line — `detectLanguage(...)` reads like code and confuses non-dev users. Proposed pill: `Detect language • en → unknown • 1 param`. On narrow screens show `Detect language • en→unknown` and provide full text via aria-label.

Renee M.: good. Make the pill focusable (role=button) so keyboard users can open the schema preview. Add `text-overflow: ellipsis` and `aria-label` with full content.

Ben K.: 3) Schema diff indicator: when a function signature changed recently show a tiny chip `Signature +2` next to the pill. Visual emphasis with an icon + neutral background. Accessibility: don't rely on color alone, include an icon and set `aria-live="polite"` so screen readers detect it when the run loads.

Olivia T.: 4) Error UX: replace blunt stack dumps in the row with calm summary text: `Tool failed to run — retry or inspect details` and hide the raw trace behind `Show error details`. Add `Retry · invocation #f12` as an accessible action.

Renee M.: ensure Retry is a real <button> and its accessible name is `Retry invocation f12` so screen readers can identify it uniquely.

Ben K.: 5) Keyboard navigation: propose `j` / `k` to move focus between runs and `Enter` to toggle details. Hotkeys must be suspended when any input or the code editor has focus. When focus lands on a run, announce the pill text with aria-live and give the card a 2px focus ring.

Olivia T.: Tooltip idea: hover/focus on function name opens a schema preview showing top 3 fields + types and a `View full schema` link. Tooltip must be keyboard openable (Enter/Space) and dismissible (Esc). For big schemas show `+N more`.

Renee M.: perf note: lazy-load preview data on first hover to avoid parsing big JSON on initial load. Cache for subsequent hovers.

Ben K.: Copy suggestions for designers (short variants):
- pill compact: `Detect language • en→unknown • 1`
- schema banner: `Signature changed: +2` / subtitle `Some runs used an older signature`
- error summary: `Tool failed to run — retry or view details`

ci-bot: Deployed playground run-row a11y + copy tweaks to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/playground (build #2026.7.13) :rocket:

Olivia T.: testing now on staging. Quick follow-ups after smoke test: 1) ensure aria-expanded toggles correctly, 2) check that schema chip is announced by screen readers, 3) confirm reduced-motion respected. I'll update the Figma notes and QA checklist once confirmed.

Renee M.: will open a small PR with the fixes and tag you both for review.

Ben K.: thanks — if QA passes let's move to prod next window.
